parameters.content:
## GostProcess Instagram DM assistant
1. Edit the **Config** node (mode stays `dry_run` until approved).
2. Select credentials on: Get Lead, Get History, Get Knowledge, Upsert Lead, Append Messages (Google Sheets), Get Profile + Send Instagram Reply (Header Auth Instagram), Call Claude (Header Auth Anthropic), Email Team (Gmail).
3. Set META_APP_SECRET and META_VERIFY_TOKEN (see docs/01-setup-guide.md).
4. Settings > Error workflow: "GostProcess IG: Error Notifier".
